reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and passes it from every existing caller instead of adding parallel logic.

duplication.why: The holiday rule is defined once in isWeekendOrHoliday, but the '+ holidays.length' look-ahead margin is repeated ad hoc in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Day classification and moving live in shared/schedules.ts, the type in types/models/schedule.ts, and parseRecurDate carries the field through.

scope.why: Only the holiday feature, its plumbing, and tests.

maintainability.why: Clean single predicate and generic stepping loop; the occurrence-window margins are heuristic and scattered.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend sites (getNextDate, schedules/app getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, budget/schedule-template) go through isWeekendOrHoliday/getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: Only the small take/margin expression is repeated, openly.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts, used by every skip and move path.
